g.text: Events in 2002–2024 · Monthly values used by the existing RO+PMM model
Shading and dots: February–June initialization months. Lines: supplied monthly PMM-SST; no additional smoothing.
2014 and 2015 are two development years of one event. All panels share the same scale; amplitude is not a regional-mean SST anomaly.
